throughline.zh: 台灣公布大南科電網與先進製程供需，新加坡更新半導體設備進度，馬來西亞及印尼則說明機房用水及跨境供電安排。
throughline.en: Taiwan reported on its science park grid and leading-edge wafer supply, Singapore added equipment milestones, and Malaysia and Indonesia addressed data center water and cross-border power.

title.zh: 台灣晶圓製程需求及廠務電力
title.en: Taiwan wafer demand and fab power

summary.zh: 台電規劃投入 1,096 億元建大南科輸變電設施，估計園區長期負載 8,000MW；立法院先前通過 711 億元撥補。台積電稱先進製程需求仍超過供給，亞力則公布在手訂單涵蓋晶圓廠和機房。
summary.en: Taipower outlined NT$109.6 billion in Greater Tainan grid work and estimated 8,000 MW of eventual load, following a separate NT$71.1 billion budget measure. TSMC reported continued leading-edge supply constraints, while Allis disclosed a backlog spanning fabs and data centers.

title.zh: 東南亞資料中心選址、供水與跨境電網
title.en: Southeast Asian data centers, water and cross-border power

summary.zh: 甘孟資料中心首期動工，初始 IT 負載規劃 10MW，馬來西亞另說明資料中心供水審查，柔佛機房業者 YTL 也回應美國遠端算力規則。印尼表示，東協跨境供電仍須按國內法規檢視。
summary.en: Gambang began construction with 10 MW of planned initial IT load, while Malaysia addressed project water checks and a Johor operator responded to the new U.S. remote compute rule. Indonesia said cross-border grid arrangements remain subject to domestic review.

title.zh: 新加坡封裝、測試及載板廠設備進度
title.en: Singapore packaging, inspection and substrate equipment milestones

summary.zh: 美光將首台 HBM 封裝設備移入新加坡廠無塵室，KLA 啟用宏茂橋 22B 廠房。迅得另稱已向新加坡高階載板廠出貨，設備已運轉。
summary.en: Micron moved the first HBM packaging tool into its Singapore cleanroom and KLA opened Ang Mo Kio Building 22B. Symtek separately reported that equipment had shipped to a Singapore advanced substrate plant and was operating.

title.zh: 半導體材料、晶圓測試及系統零組件
title.en: Semiconductor materials, wafer test and system components

summary.zh: 漢測公布 10 月自結實績，登豐則說明 DGX Spark 的電源晶片採用。晶呈公布特氣出貨與玻璃通孔產線規劃，南寶及立碁分別有用膠供貨與光收發模組送樣進度。
summary.en: Hermes Testing released preliminary October results and GST disclosed a DGX Spark power IC design. Jingcheng gave specialty gas and glass via updates, alongside reported progress in Nan Pao adhesives and Ligitek optical module sampling.

title.zh: 電子工廠投資、製造設備與循環材料政策
title.en: Electronics factory investment, machine tools and circular materials policy

summary.zh: 訊芯核准增資越南子公司，GIS-KY 越南子公司公告機電安裝契約。台灣則披露國產半導體腔體工具機取得德國訂單，環境部也說明跨境循環材料合作方向。
summary.en: ShunSin approved an equity injection for its Vietnam subsidiary, while GIS-KY’s Vietnam unit disclosed an electromechanical installation contract. Taiwan reported German orders for semiconductor chamber tools and outlined cooperation on cross-border recycled materials.
